rules: Same ratchet-down-only policy as the live site's tool/page-budget.json (see its 'rules' field): any PR that reduces exampleSite page weight must lower maxPageBytes (or a tightened override) in the same PR — reclaimed bytes are banked, never slack. Home has NO override — it must fit the default budget for real. Ratchet history: Task 13 first trimmed home from 137,669/138,334 B to under 135,000 B (pricing teaser simplified to a plans-only summary, redundant <title> fixed); a later fix round reverted an over-aggressive content-count cut (all 6 problems/6 services_extract items restored, both locales) and instead freed the needed bytes from fraunces-roman.woff2 (self-hosted display font, narrowed wght axis + opsz pinned per the typography owner's verdict — see tool/subset_fonts.sh), which dropped home to ~106,000 B and every other exampleSite page by the same ~29 KB, so maxPageBytes ratcheted down from 135,000 to 123,000 (~15% over the new heaviest regular page, same margin methodology as the live site's own baseline+15%). image-bearing pages below get a justified per-page override instead of a global raise.

/styleguide/.justification: Unlisted internal demo/reference page — every component in one place, including a full Figure section with a real image; not a page a template consumer ships, so a wider budget doesn't cost real visitors anything. Ratcheted down from 148,000 alongside the font-driven site-wide drop.

/products/notably/.justification: Product detail page renders a real product screenshot via the figure pipeline (AVIF/WebP/srcset) — image-bearing by design, per the ratchet policy. Ratcheted down from 150,000 alongside the font-driven site-wide drop.
